test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: A number is divisible by 3 only when:

options.text: the difference of the sum of the odd and the even digits is divisible by 3
the sum of its digits is divisible by 3
the last digit is either 0 or an even number
the last two digits are divisible by 3

solution:
**Calculation:**

The divisibility test of 3 is: The sum of digits of a number must be divisible by 3.

∴ The correct answer is option 2
